name: SAMAT
blurb: A full-service South American international carrier connecting its Santiago, São Paulo and Buenos Aires hubs with the Americas, Europe and beyond.

about: South American Air Transport, known as SAMAT, was founded in 2002 and is owned by SAMAT Group. Headquartered across Santiago, São Paulo, Buenos Aires and Bogotá, the full-service carrier combines South American hospitality with a modern international operation.

Following decades of development, SAMAT has established itself as a major fictional aviation brand. Its diverse Airbus, Boeing, ATR and Bombardier fleet supports domestic, regional South American and long-haul services as the airline strengthens connections between South America and the rest of the world. SAMAT — Aquí para Sudamérica.
network: Santiago is SAMAT's headquarters and principal hub, supported by major hubs at São Paulo Guarulhos and Buenos Aires Ezeiza. Bogotá, Lima and Santa Cruz serve as focus cities for a network reaching Europe, North America, Central America and destinations across South America.
